title: Bellman Calibration for Marginalized Importance Weighting in Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24858v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Marginalized importance weighting evaluates a target policy by reweighting offline state-action samples with its discounted occupancy ratio, characterized by an adjoint Bellman equation. Existing minimax, primal-dual, and fitted fixed-point estimators can leave residual occupancy-balance violations because of function-class approximation, regularization, or incomplete optimization. These violations are difficult to diagnose and reduce because the objectives generally lack a direct supervised validation loss for hyperparameter tuning, model selection, and early stopping. We introduce isotonic Bellman calibration, a one-dimensional, model-agnostic post-processing method that reduces these violations while preserving the ranking information in any initial occupancy-ratio estimate. translated_title: 离线强化学习中边际化重要性加权的贝尔曼校准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24858v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：边际化重要性加权通过使用其折扣占用比率重新加权离线状态-动作样本来评估目标策略，该比率由伴随贝尔曼方程表征。现有的极小极大、原始-对偶和拟合固定点估计器可能由于函数类近似、正则化或不完全优化而留下残余的占用平衡违规。这些违规难以诊断和减少，因为目标通常缺乏用于超参数调优、模型选择和早停的直接监督验证损失。我们引入了等渗贝尔曼校准，这是一种一维、模型无关的后处理方法，可减少这些违规，同时保留任何初始占用比率估计中的排序信息。该方法通过在一类非递减变换上应用拟合占用比率评估（FORE）来校正估计的尺度和形状。
tldr: 提出一种一维、模型无关的等渗贝尔曼校准后处理方法，通过非递减变换校正占用比率估计的尺度和形状，减少离线强化学习中边际化重要性加权的残余违规，同时保留排序信息。
en_tdlr: We propose an isotonic Bellman calibration, a one-dimensional, model-agnostic post-processing method that corrects the scale and shape of occupancy-ratio estimates via nondecreasing transformations, reducing residual violations in marginalized importance weighting for offline reinforcement learning while preserving ranking information.
